The main takeaway from our work is that
CINs show a postnatal emergence of plateau potential capability that is mediated by 5-HT-induced increases in I(Ca(L)).
the developmental increase in CIN excitability and 5-HT-induced plateau potentials in CINs is due to the emergence of I(Ca(L)).
